explainer: Manual checklist for checking prompt metadata sidecars against prompt files.
how_it_works: Use this checklist as a manual review guide before copying, exporting, importing, or releasing prompt-library material.
risks: A prompt library can drift if prompts, metadata, and stacks are not reviewed together.
mitigations: Run this checklist before treating prompt-library material as ready for reuse.
safe_usage: Use as a text-only QA checklist. It does not modify source code, runtime behavior, or governance.
example_usage: Review each checklist item and mark pass, fail, or not applicable before a prompt pack is copied to another project.

change_log.summary: Initial text-only Prompt Library QA checklist metadata.
